title: Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Red is told he is 'not a true comrade' and kicked out of the Hero's party fighting the demon lord's army, so he moves to a distant frontier town to open an apothecary and live quietly (Yen Press blurb via AniList and MU). His peace is disrupted when Rit, a former party member and a princess, arrives and asks to move in with him, and keeping his past secret becomes harder (AniList; MU Cohabitation, Hidden Past). Adapted from Zappon's light novel.
life_message: A quiet life of useful work, love and small comforts can be worth more than glory on the front lines.

folkways.japan: Reflects the Japanese 'slow life' fantasy subgenre, a reaction to overwork and rigid career paths.

delivery.note: The value of a quiet life is carried by Red's daily routine; how the hero's party is portrayed needs a full read.

winners_losers: Red and Rit gain a peaceful home; the glory-driven hero's world is the foil. Sympathy goes to ordinary contentment.
